bonusGame.hidingDescription: Help the Hobbits hide! Click hiding spots to find safe places and earn rewards. Find 4 safe spots—or get caught!

bonusGame.title: BONUS GAME
bonusGame.scatterDescription:
Land Witch King SCATTERs to trigger BONUS
Game. The number of SCATTERs determines
your multiplier for rewards.
bonusGame.instruction: Choose hiding spots one by one to help the Hobbits hide.
bonusGame.scatterAwards:
3 Scatters 1x Multiplier
4 Scatters 2x Multiplier
5 Scatters 5x Multiplier

freespin.title: FREESPIN
freespin.mapDescription:
After every winning spin, the
Fellowship moves further
along their quest.
Reaching specific waypoints
triggers the Free Spins feature.
freespin.rivendell:
5 Free Spins. The reels are enriched
with extra Medium symbols.
freespin.lothlorien:
10 Free Spins. The reels are enriched
with extra High symbols.
freespin.mountDoom:
15 Free Spins. The One Ring
becomes a Sticky Wild for the
duration.

jackpot.title: JACKPOT
jackpot.stickyRingsDescription:
During these 15 Free Spins, every One Ring symbol that
lands becomes a Sticky Wild, locking into place for the
remainder of the round.
jackpot.collectRings:
Collect the Rings during the Free Spins and claim your
reward based on how many you collect:
<ringCount>3 Rings:</ringCount> <reward>100x</reward>
<ringCount>6 Rings:</ringCount> <reward>150x</reward>
<ringCount>9 Rings:</ringCount> <reward>GRAND JACKPOT!!!</reward>
jackpot.note: Other wild and scatter will not appear during the Mount Doom Free Spin

lorePayout.title: LORE PAYOUT
lorePayout.instruction:
Land the exact symbol combination in a single column to
trigger a specific storyline and earn an extra payout.

paytable.title: PAYTABLE
paytable.matchDescription:
LINE UP 3 MATCHING
SYMBOLS IN THE SAME
COLUMN TO WIN

wildScatter.title: WILD & SCATTER
wildScatter.conditionalWild: Conditional <wild>WILD</wild>. Substitutes for all Low value symbols.
wildScatter.wild: <wild>WILD</wild>. Substitutes for all symbols except for scatter.
wildScatter.respinScatter:
Respin SCATTER: Every time it lands, summon an Orc Uruk-Hai
that locks up to 6 high-value symbols in place, then triggers a Respin.
The Respin SCATTER cannot appear again for 10 spins.
wildScatter.bonusScatter:
SCATTER. Land 3, 4, or 5 SCATTERS to trigger the BONUS
GAME.
